description: This file contains extension methods for working with symbols in Roslyn's API, specifically for handling type symbols, attribute analysis, and name/type syntax conversions within the Orleans code generation context.

classes.name: SymbolExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for Roslyn symbols to facilitate code analysis and generation tasks related to type and attribute information.

methods.name: HasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a symbol has a specific attribute, optionally inherited.

methods.name: GetAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the attribute data if a symbol has a specific attribute, optionally considering inheritance.

methods.name: ToTypeSyntax
methods.description: Converts an ITypeSymbol to a Roslyn TypeSyntax, with overloads supporting substitutions and open generic types.

methods.name: ToDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable display name for a symbol, considering options for namespace and global specifier.

methods.name: GetValidIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a valid C# identifier string based on the symbol's type data.

methods.name: HasBaseType
methods.description: Checks if a type symbol has a specific base type.

methods.name: HasAnyAttribute
methods.description: Determines if a symbol has any attributes matching a list of attribute types.

methods.name: GetAllMembers
methods.description: Retrieves all members of a specific name and accessibility in a type hierarchy.

methods.name: GetDeclaredInstanceMembers
methods.description: Enumerates instance members declared in the specific type.

methods.name: GetNamespaceAndNesting
methods.description: Builds a string representing the namespace and nesting hierarchy of a symbol.

methods.name: GetAllTypeParameters
methods.description: Retrieves all type parameters in a type, including nested ones.

methods.name: GetAllTypeArguments
methods.description: Retrieves all type arguments in a type, including nested ones.

methods.name: IsAssignableFrom
methods.description: Checks if one type symbol is assignable from another, considering inheritance and interfaces.

methods.name: GetDeclaredTypes
methods.description: Enumerates all declared types within an assembly's modules.
